blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Deep in the vast forests of America, maj
blocks_element.text:
Deep in the vast forests of America, majestic elk roam freely. Every year, as part of nature's cycle, they shed their antlers.

This is an event that occurs naturally, without human interference.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · In the absence of man-made chew toys, cr
blocks_element.text:
In the absence of man-made chew toys, creatures like wolves and coyotes naturally gravitated toward these antlers for thousands of years. They don't want artificially flavored toys or strange-sounding treats.

They instinctively know that wild antlers are the real deal, tough enough for their fierce jaws.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Inspired by nature and the ancestral bon
blocks_element.text:
Inspired by nature and the ancestral bond between dogs and wolves, we are dedicated to offering our dogs this authentic experience. We supply long-lasting, high-quality genuine elk antlers, and rest assured, no elk are harmed in the process. Elk Antlers stand out as nature's ideal chew.

They're a testament to the beauty of the natural world, providing a safe and satisfying experience for our dogs.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · How long do they last?
Paragraphe · This depends on your dog and the size of
blocks_element.text:
This depends on your dog and the size of antler you pick.

If you choose the correct size whole antler, we've heard stories of them lasting for over five years but a few months is very typical.

For split antlers, it will depend on your dog's chewing power and if they chew out the marrow and not the casing, which shortens antler life. Expect a week to a couple of months. They still last longer than the vast majority of other chews, but there is no hard and fast rule.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Are they safe for my dog’s teeth?
blocks_element.text: Are they safe for my dog’s teeth?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Dogs will be dogs and need to chew. Ever
blocks_element.text:
Dogs will be dogs and need to chew. 

Every dog chew assumes some risk of breaking a tooth and by not giving your dog something good to chew on, they may take a bite out of your hard dining room chair or a rock in your yard. That is far more dangerous than having a suitable dog chew. 

Also, gnawing on Elk Antlers cleans away plaque and tartar, and they contain minerals like calcium, magnesium, and phosphate that strengthen teeth. Ultimately, you should make the best decision for your dog.

The two main factors are knowing your dog has healthy teeth and making sure they gnaw going side to side with their back teeth and don't bite down hard like on a carrot.  

From our experience, when this advice is followed, teeth breaks are rare and your dog is spared from chewing on other dangerous things.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Should I buy Whole or Split?
blocks_element.text: Should I buy Whole or Split?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Want something that will never splinter?
blocks_element.text:
Want something that will never splinter? 

Choose our Whole Elk Antlers. 

Need something softer for an older dog or young puppy with weaker teeth or want to entice a first-time antler chewer with deliciously exposed marrow?

Go for our split antlers. 

Both antler styles give your dog a safe chewing experience while whitening their teeth. However, split antlers because they've been cut can occasionally splinter if your dog is a power chewer. This is especially true for smaller sizes.

Most regular dogs do great with split antlers which are a durable chew but always supervise your dog.
